_doc: The research behind the three source tiers (ADR 0009, docs/features/jobseeker/README.md). `termsQuote` is the clause SUMMARY the owner acknowledges (paraphrased where the original is Czech/Slovak or paywalled behind a login; `termsUrl` is where to read the original — verify before relying on it), and `termsHash` in the API is sha256 of it, so a changed summary re-asks the owner. `robotsSummary` records what robots.txt said on the date in `checkedOn`. Tier C entries are listed so the UI can say WHY they are refused; they are never fetched.

entries.label: EURES (European Labour Authority)
entries.robotsSummary: Public JSON search API under /eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/ — an API, not a crawled page.
entries.termsQuote: EURES vacancy data is published by the European Labour Authority for job seekers' use; reuse is permitted with attribution to the source. This installation identifies itself and attributes 'Data: EURES / European Labour Authority' on every posting it shows.
entries.cadenceNote: Twice daily is plenty: the search returns the most recent first and the page size is 50.

entries.label: MPSV open data — volná místa (Czech labour office)
entries.termsQuote: Published as open data by the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs under an open licence permitting reuse with attribution. The full file is ~184 MB and is read as a stream; a daily delta file exists on the portal and can be set as config.url.
entries.cadenceNote: The file is regenerated daily; once a day per install is the honest cadence, the scan skips the source when lastRunAt is under 20 h old.

entries.label: Arbeitnow (EU and remote jobs API)
entries.robotsSummary: robots.txt allows every path for every agent (only a tracking query is disallowed); the API is a documented public JSON endpoint at /api/job-board-api, no key.
entries.termsQuote: The API payload states: 'This is a free public API for jobs, please do not abuse. I would appreciate linking back to the site. By using the API, you agree to the terms of service present on Arbeitnow.com.' The terms of service add: 'You also agree to providing a link back to Arbeitnow.com on your platform. We may revoke the permission to use API at any time.' No clause forbids automated use of the API. This installation keeps each posting's own Arbeitnow URL, links to it, and attributes 'Jobs via Arbeitnow.com' on every posting it shows.
entries.cadenceNote: Jobs are refreshed hourly upstream; twice a day is plenty. At most 4 pages of 250 per scan, filtered locally by your titles and places (the API has no search parameter).

entries.label: Greenhouse job board (per company token)
entries.robotsSummary: Public Job Board API, documented for third-party use; no key.
entries.termsQuote: The Job Board API is provided for displaying a company's open jobs on external sites; the company controls what is published.
entries.cadenceNote: One request per scan per company.

entries.label: Lever postings (per company site)
entries.robotsSummary: Public Postings API; EU tenants on api.eu.lever.co.
entries.termsQuote: The Postings API exposes a company's published postings for embedding on external sites without authentication.
entries.cadenceNote: One request per scan per company.

entries.label: Recruitee careers site API (per company)
entries.termsQuote: The careers site API serves the company's published offers to its own careers page and integrations.
entries.cadenceNote: One request per scan per company.

entries.label: Teamtailor jobs RSS (per company)
entries.termsQuote: The RSS feed is the company's published job list for syndication.
entries.cadenceNote: One request per scan per company.

entries.label: Personio careers XML (per company)
entries.termsQuote: The XML feed exists for job boards and multiposting partners to read a company's published positions.
entries.cadenceNote: One request per scan per company.

entries.label: Workable careers widget API (per company subdomain)
entries.termsQuote: The widget API serves a company's published jobs to its own careers page embed.
entries.cadenceNote: One request per scan per company.

entries.label: Ashby posting API (per job board name)
entries.robotsSummary: Public posting API, documented; compensation included on request.
entries.termsQuote: The Posting API is intended for displaying a company's published jobs on external sites; no authentication.
entries.cadenceNote: One request per scan per company.

entries.label: SmartRecruiters posting API (per company)
entries.robotsSummary: Public Posting API; the vendor asks for at most 10 requests per second.
entries.termsQuote: The Posting API is public and rate-limited to 10 requests per second per client; postings are the company's published jobs.
entries.cadenceNote: One list request plus one detail request per new posting, spaced 2 s+ apart by the fetcher.

entries.label: StartupJobs.cz
entries.robotsSummary: robots.txt permits offer pages and publishes a sitemap; detail pages carry schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD.
entries.termsQuote: VOP čl. 10 odst. 2 (summary): systematic extraction or reuse of the database content, including by automated means, is prohibited without the operator's consent. Enabling this source means the owner of this installation takes that exposure for their own job search.
entries.cadenceNote: At most twice a day; sitemap first, detail pages only for new URLs.

entries.label: Prace.cz (Alma Career)
entries.robotsSummary: robots.txt permits offer pages; detail pages carry JobPosting JSON-LD.
entries.termsQuote: Alma Career terms of use (summary): content may not be processed by automated means, copied or reused outside the service without the operator's written consent. Enabling this source means the owner takes that exposure for their own job search.
entries.cadenceNote: At most twice a day; detail pages only for new URLs.

entries.label: Profesia.sk (Alma Career)
entries.robotsSummary: robots.txt permits offer pages; detail pages carry JobPosting JSON-LD.
entries.termsQuote: VOP čl. 38 písm. e) (summary): using bots or other automated tools to read or copy the service's content is a breach that may lead to termination of access. Enabling this source means the owner takes that exposure for their own job search.
entries.cadenceNote: At most twice a day; detail pages only for new URLs.

entries.label: Cocuma.cz
entries.robotsSummary: robots.txt permits job pages; detail pages carry JobPosting JSON-LD.
entries.termsQuote: No explicit anti-scraping clause was found in the published terms on the date checked; the site is nevertheless a database whose operator has not consented to automated reading, so it is listed as tier B and enabling it is the owner's acknowledged decision.
entries.cadenceNote: At most twice a day; detail pages only for new URLs.

entries.label: Jobs.cz (Alma Career)
entries.robotsSummary: robots.txt permits listing and offer pages; NO sitemap of offers and NO JobPosting JSON-LD on detail pages, hence authored extraction rules over the server-rendered listing.
entries.termsQuote: Alma Career terms of use (summary): content may not be processed by automated means, copied or reused outside the service without the operator's written consent. Enabling this source means the owner takes that exposure for their own job search.
entries.cadenceNote: At most twice a day; a few listing pages plus detail pages for new offers only.

entries.label: LinkedIn Jobs
entries.robotsSummary: robots.txt disallows crawling for all but a named list of agents, and the response headers say the same.
entries.termsQuote: User Agreement §8.2 (summary): you agree not to use bots, scrapers or other automated methods to access the Services or copy profiles and other data.
entries.refusedReason: Terms forbid automated access and robots.txt disallows it; LinkedIn litigates scraping.

entries.label: Indeed
entries.robotsSummary: Requests without a browser session answer 403 behind a bot wall.
entries.termsQuote: Terms of Service (summary): scraping, crawling or otherwise using automated means to access the site or collect job listings is prohibited without Indeed's express written permission.
entries.refusedReason: 403 bot wall plus an explicit anti-scraping clause.

entries.label: StepStone
entries.robotsSummary: robots.txt disallows the job search paths; the pages sit behind a bot wall.
entries.termsQuote: Terms of use (summary): automated reading, crawling or scraping of the platform's content is not permitted.
entries.refusedReason: Explicit anti-scraping clause and a bot wall.
